text:
eva-ml: heads-up — dashboard scoreboard shows quantized-llama-v2 (fp8) run has +3.2% RL-BLEU vs float32 on newsbench. feels wrong :thinking:

praveen: which metric / link?

eva-ml: rl-bleu. here: https://console.redwood.internal/scorecards/2289

lin: what's the sample count per run?

eva-ml: quantized N=120, float32 N=1000. small sample but the chart is scaling it weirdly.

julian: small-N could definitely spike. also check tokenization — did the runner use the new SPM vocab?

anya: +1 — last week we had a tokenizer mismatch where short prompts collapsed leading to artificially high BLEU.

eva-ml: good catch. I pulled the runner logs, looks like the eval harness used `tokenizer=v1` not `tokenizer=v2`.

praveen: can you paste the runner cmd and the SQL we use for the dashboard export? might be a join that drops samples.

eva-ml:
```
# runner command
tools/eval-runner run --suite newsbench --model quantized-llama-v2 --tokenizer v1 --seed 7 --samples 120

# export used by dashboard
SELECT model, metric, COUNT(*) as cnt, AVG(value) as avg_val
FROM eval_results
WHERE suite='newsbench' AND run_ts > 2288000000
GROUP BY model, metric;
```

lin: that SELECT will drop samples if there are NULL values in `value`. dashboard expects `cnt` from `runs_samples` table. possible join mismatch.

ci-bot: CI: eval-runner/2289 failed — test_eval_results_count_mismatch (exit 1)

praveen: okay. action items:
- re-run quantized model with tokenizer=v2 and samples=1000
- fix export SQL to use LEFT JOIN and COALESCE(value, 0) where appropriate
- add a note in metric defs: RL-BLEU requires consistent tokenization & min-sample threshold

anya: I'll submit a tiny PR to the dashboard SQL and add the threshold guard in the frontend (hide deltas if N < 200). :hammer_and_wrench:

julian: I'll queue the re-run now with seed=42 and post results. command:
`tools/eval-runner run --suite newsbench --model quantized-llama-v2 --tokenizer v2 --seed 42 --samples 1000 --tag fix-tokenizer-2289`

ops-bot: Scheduled task: eval-runner job queued (job_id=er-2289-retry) ETA ~ 10m.

eva-ml: thanks. can we also add an alert so future dashboard diffs check sample counts before showing percent deltas? saw a user-facing ticket earlier.

praveen: yes — add a backend guard + UI tooltip. I'll add to sprint board.

ops-bot: Job er-2289-retry started at 2289000500.

eva-ml: great — I'll monitor. will post summary when done. :sparkles:
